description: Says whether a domain is on SignupBouncer's disposable (burner) email list, only on an old burner list (a challenge, not a block), a known relay service or a free subdomain mail service, or a known real mailbox provider, and when our harvester observed it. Uses only the loaded lists, no DNS lookup, so a brand-new burner domain on a burner mail server is caught only by check_email. Accepts a domain or an email address.

domain.description: A domain such as mailinator.com, or an email address.

name: lookup_burner_domain
